notes.list_status: Post-deadline. The widget marks no council race acclaimed or withdrawn; its only '(Acclaimed)' heading is a Conseil scolaire Viamonde trustee.
notes.source_note: district_source_url includes planyourvote.voterview.ca/candidate-list, which is a JavaScript app and returns nothing to a plain fetch. Read in the browser. The widget exposes surname and given name in separate DOM fields (.candidate__lastname / .candidate__firstname), so names here are not parsed - they are taken as published. The surnames only look upper-case on screen: the DOM holds 'McCarney' and CSS applies text-transform: uppercase, so the DOM text is what is recorded.
notes.structure_match: Both Town Councillor and Regional Councillor still appear for all four wards (North 1, West 2, Centre 3, East 4), each 'one to be elected'. This independently confirms the classification-overrides.csv revision for Whitby: regional councillors are elected by ward (Ward/SMD) for 2026, not at large.
notes.district_names: Whitby's wards carry compass names; recorded as published, e.g. 'North Ward 1'.
notes.position: From the widget's race headings, 'Town Councillor North Ward 1 (one to be elected)' and 'Regional Councillor North Ward 1 (one to be elected)'.
